threshold_note: Positive reinforcement (crates/engine/src/praise.rs). Every call names one good decision the frames proved, with the numbers that prove it; a praise is said only in a calm moment (alive, health read twice at 60%+, not falling, no enemy marker within near_radius, not carrying the urn, the team not wiped) and the engine allows at most 3 per 10 minutes, 60 s apart (praise::MIN_GAP_SECS / PER_WINDOW). Thresholds are coach heuristics tuned on rec12 (a 12/3/11 Grey Talon win) and checked for false praise on rec5 / rec8 / rec11, not game rules. Distances are minimap fractions.

cards.speech: Good use of the {time} window: with {count} enemies dead, {what}.
cards.rationale: Two or more enemies on respawn timers is a numbers advantage; the frames showed it converted (you in their half with a teammate, a lane front moving up, or their structure's health banner).

sources.excerpt: count survivors and take the highest-value safe action (objective, wave, reset) rather than chasing

sources.section: ### When ahead (net worth lead, more towers/structures)

cards.speech: Urn delivered: about {gain} souls. Walking it straight in was the right call.
cards.rationale: Carrying the urn, then your souls jumping by the urn's value within seconds of the carry ending, is a delivery.

sources.excerpt: if not denied all go to the courier

cards.speech: Good shopping: you spent {spent} souls on the death screen and came back stronger.
cards.rationale: The death screen is a shop window; the souls read on it fell from at least the tier normally bought then to below it.

sources.excerpt: Do not hoard souls through fights; buy during respawn or at the base.

cards.speech: Good timing: you spent {spent} souls {secs} seconds after reaching {tier}.
cards.rationale: Souls reached the tier normally bought at this game time (economy::spend_target) and fell back below it within a minute.

sources.section: ### When ahead (net worth lead, more towers/structures)
sources.excerpt: Spend souls immediately; unspent souls are wasted power.
Shop after major value spikes so a fragile lead does not enter a fight unspent

cards.speech: {min} minutes without dying{since}. You've been dead {pct}% of the game: that keeps us at full strength.
cards.rationale: No death screen since the match start (watched from the first two minutes) or since the last respawn, without recording gaps.

sources.excerpt: each death costs both time off the map and souls.
Downtime: respawning, idly waiting, aimless rotation.

cards.speech: You walked out with a teammate this time. After {deaths} alone, that's the fix.
cards.rationale: An earlier death came with every visible teammate a quarter of the map away; after this respawn an allied marker stayed beside you on the way out.

sources.section: ### When ahead (net worth lead, more towers/structures)

sources.excerpt: Fall back and regroup. Don't fight split.

cards.speech: Our soul lead grew from {from} at {time} to {to} at {at}.{share} Keep grouping for objectives.
cards.rationale: Team totals read without a digit drop or a jump, a lead of at least 15% that grew by 4,000+ souls over the last 4-8 minutes and held on the last three readings.

sources.excerpt: Gold/souls lead converts to item lead then fights then objectives

sources.section: ### When ahead (net worth lead, more towers/structures)
sources.excerpt: Convert the lead into objectives, not kills.
